title: Concept Hierarchy - Definition of Instances
description: JSON Schema for validating instance definitions in the Concept Hierarchy

^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$.description: Instance = Global variable (can start with upper or lowercase letter)

instanceDefinition.description: Value of an instance: can be any JSON value, ValueDomain creation, Function procedure, or reference to another instance

oneOf.description: Either a string literal (with s: prefix) or reference to another instance
Could be: plain JSON object, ValueDomain creation, Function procedure, or CustomFunction definition. RECURSION POINT - add maxDepth here if needed
